units.source_text: 吃饭的时候，夫人把坐在一旁的女佣打发开，亲自为我们盛饭。

en.t: At mealtime, Madam sent away the maid sitting nearby and served rice to us herself.

units.source_text: 这似乎是先生家招待老朋友的习惯。

en.t: This seemed to be the custom in Sensei's house when entertaining old friends.

units.source_text: 头一两次我还感到不好意思，后来次数多了，便不觉得把饭碗递给夫人有什么不好的了。

en.t: The first once or twice I still felt embarrassed, but after it happened many times, I no longer felt there was anything improper about handing my rice bowl to Madam.

units.source_text: “要茶，还是添饭？

en.t: Tea, or more rice?

units.source_text: 你胃口不错啊。”

en.t: You have a good appetite, don't you?

units.source_text: 夫人有时也会开个玩笑，可是那天我的食欲并没有像夫人说的那样好。

en.t: Madam sometimes made little jokes too, but that day my appetite was not as good as she said it was.

units.source_text: “已经吃饱了？

en.t: Already full?

units.source_text: 近来你的饭量也太小了。”

en.t: Lately you have been eating far too little.

units.source_text: “不是饭量小了，是天气热，吃不下。”

en.t: It is not that I am eating less; it is hot, so I cannot eat.

units.source_text: 夫人叫女佣收拾了饭桌后，又叫她把冰激凌和水果送上来。

en.t: After Madam had the maid clear the dining table, she had her bring out ice cream and fruit.

units.source_text: “这是我自己做的。”

en.t: I made this myself.

units.source_text: 看来在家无所事事的夫人，有闲暇自己调制冰激凌请客人品尝，我连吃了两杯。

en.t: It seemed that Madam, idle at home, had the leisure to make ice cream herself for guests to taste, and I ate two bowls in a row.

units.source_text: “你也终于毕业了，以后打算干什么呢？”先生问我。

en.t: Now that you have finally graduated too, what do you plan to do next? Sensei asked me.

units.source_text: 先生把坐垫向走廊上移了一半，背靠在隔扇门上。

en.t: Sensei had moved his cushion halfway toward the veranda and was leaning his back against the sliding partition.

units.source_text: 我只想到要毕业了，至于以后干什么却没想过。

en.t: I had only thought about graduating, and had not considered what I would do afterward.

units.source_text: 夫人见我犹豫不决，回答不出，便问道：“当老师？”

en.t: Seeing me hesitate and fail to answer, Madam asked, A teacher?

units.source_text: 我还是没有回答。

en.t: Still I did not answer.

units.source_text: 夫人又问：“那就是，做官？”

en.t: Madam asked again, Then perhaps a government official?

units.source_text: 我和先生都笑了起来。

en.t: Sensei and I both burst out laughing.

units.source_text: “说真的，我还没有什么具体打算。

en.t: To tell the truth, I still do not have any definite plans.

units.source_text: 关于选择什么职业的问题，我真是一点也没考虑过。

en.t: As for the question of what occupation to choose, I truly have not thought about it at all.

units.source_text: 因为究竟干什么好，干什么不好，不实际体验是不会知道的。

en.t: Because in the end, unless I actually try things for myself, I cannot know what is good to do and what is not.

units.source_text: 所以我也无法选择。”

en.t: That is why I cannot choose.
